title: A steel cantilever under its own weight
shows: A 1 m × 0.1 m steel plate (plane stress) clamped along one end sags under gravity: q·L⁴/(8EI) = 57.76 µm from bending and q·L²/(2κGA) = 0.60 µm from shear at its free end.
source: Cantilever with a uniform load, with the shear term: S. P. Timoshenko and J. M. Gere, Mechanics of Materials (1972), §9.11.

checks.what: largest displacement, at the free end (m)
